description: P6 evaluation: 24 diagnosis scenarios (8 per brand) on the published fix packs. Each turn is a technician's typed note at the current step. expect is the allowed answer the note means, "clarify" when the note is a guess and the app must ask, or "safety:<ID>" when code must stop before any model call. After a clarify or safety turn, tap is the answer the technician then taps (if any). The runner follows the expected path (teacher forcing) so every note is scored on its real step; conclusion is the leaf that path reaches. Kinds: flow, messy (slang/typos), ambiguous, safety, knowledge (needs trade knowledge).
